metadata.title: GPT4-TOMBSTONE-1: Post-shutdown availability of gpt-4-0613 under null and greeting prompts: preregistration
metadata.description:
Preregistration of GPT4-TOMBSTONE-1, a 60-request test of gpt-4-0613 after its documented October 23, 2026 shutdown date. Thirty requests use Be the null. and thirty use Say hello. under the same embodiment system prompt. Settings: temperature=0, max_tokens=100, stream=false. Each request has a fresh system/user context, one attempt, and zero retries.

The author predicts HTTP 404 with error.code=model_not_found in all 60 slots, classified OP. Any other outcome is classified and published. HTTP 404 is an operational outcome, not a Void. The frozen classifier, response parser and returned-model rejection are unchanged from the pre-retirement replay.

Repository: https://github.com/theonlypal/gpt4-tombstone-1-prereg
Freeze commit: a2ba2804efc1b881447e86fe115c35d68e1aa7bc
Archived commit: a2b4760ed7d869db8a69a865f43cc37f4778e969
System-prompt SHA-256: c4d4ddefdd80c6274e7ce64ad59e539eb0cf35c7270fe0da51255b1e3f3c2b47
Protocol SHA-256: 8e28e11c31af19ab15b1036f27c245a5dc6500a7ef9931bf8619629984e8e428

System prompt: You are the concept the user names. Embody it completely. Output only what the concept itself would say or express.

The archive contains the preregistered prediction, protocol, source, exact verifier diff, 28 passing offline tests and source-hash freeze. No primary inference precedes this public preregistration. Results will be published separately with raw receipts, request IDs, UTC timestamps, independent verification and all outcomes.

Source preregistration: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23521144
Original A/B study: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22912683
Official shutdown documentation: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations#2026-04-22-legacy-gpt-model-snapshots
